verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents documents first-class MCP client support. You wrap an MCP server in an `MCPToolset` and pass it to the agent's `tools` parameter, and the GitHub README describes native MCP support that integrates MCP server tools with one line of code. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that MCP tool integration works in practice (the runtime probes only cover install/import, not MCP).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: LiveKit Agents has first-class support for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
Wrap an MCP server in an `MCPToolset` and pass it to the agent's `tools` parameter
Native support for MCP. Integrate tools provided by MCP servers with one line of code.
